name: ProtonPlus
tagline: Manage Proton, Wine, DXVK, and VKD3D tools for Linux game launchers
blurb: ProtonPlus helps you install, update, remove, and organize Windows compatibility tools used by Steam and other Linux game launchers.
description:
ProtonPlus helps you install, update, remove, and organize Windows compatibility tools used by Steam and other Linux game launchers.

• Manage Proton, Wine, DXVK, VKD3D, and related compatibility tools

• Support Steam, Faugus Launcher, Lutris, Heroic Games Launcher, Bottles, and WineZGUI

• Browse Steam games, change compatibility tools, and edit launch options

• Track downloads and updates, with cancellation and desktop notifications

• Use the command-line interface to list, install, update, and uninstall tools

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
